title: Microtubules / Tubulin / Body-Mind-Spirit — Recovery and Physics Audit
status: primary project prompt + Great Book neuroscience/quantum-consciousness archaeology + multiscale scientific audit
abstract: The microtubule/tubulin branch is scientifically meaningful only if it is split into levels and connected by explicit causal maps. Microtubules are established cytoskeletal polymers central to neuronal polarity, intracellular transport and structural plasticity. The Great Book and later project discussions additionally explore electromagnetic, oscillatory and quantum-consciousness roles. A rigorous research programme therefore starts with classical microtubule mechanics/electrodynamics and transport biology, defines candidate microscopic state variables, measures their coupling to membrane/cytoskeletal/neuronal dynamics, and only then tests whether a specifically quantum description is necessary. Any quantum branch must specify a Hamiltonian, environmental coupling, coherence observable and timescale, and must show how the microscopic state changes a neural variable that in turn affects behavior or conscious report. The mere presence of quantum effects in molecules is insufficient. The strongest project contribution is a multiscale interface question—whether microtubules can function as a Door between molecular and neural levels—rather than a predeclared claim of nonlocal consciousness. This programme is T1-T2: grounded in real cell biology, equipped with testable physical submodels, but lacking evidence that uniquely quantum microtubule processes are required for consciousness.
research_question: Do microtubule/tubulin dynamics contribute causally to neural computation or conscious-state variables in a way that survives multiscale controls, and if so, is any specifically quantum description experimentally necessary beyond classical biochemical/mechanical/electrical models?
importance: The user's remembered 'tubals/microtubals' strand is real and substantial. Microtubules appear both in the 2024 Great Book's Body-Mind-Spirit/Human Map model and later explicit user prompts tying tubulars/microtubules to Spiral, Tree of Strife, advanced/retarded waves and the Axis. Later dialogue sometimes over-literalized these links into unsupported quantum/social claims; this record preserves the lineage while separating the viable research questions.
maturity: Established biology at L0; project multiscale model T1-T2; quantum-consciousness necessity unestablished
primary_project_recovery: A later user prompt explicitly says to consider 'tubulars even, and microtubules' alongside spooky action at a distance/quantum entanglement, Tree of Strife, upward/downward spiral, advanced/retarded waves, solar-system effects and Axis Mundi.
The Great Book independently contains a detailed microtubule/tubulin section inside the Spirit/non-local layer of a Body-Mind-Spirit Human Map.

The Great Book also contains consciousness mathematics including a logarithmic spiral, Kuramoto-like synchronization, Schrodinger/Bell/Maxwell comparators, CSF oscillation toy models, connectivity statistics and fractal measures.

facts: Microtubules are polymers built from alpha/beta-tubulin heterodimers and are major components of the eukaryotic cytoskeleton.
In neurons they help establish polarity, provide tracks for intracellular transport, participate in axon/dendrite development and remodeling, and interact with many microtubule-associated proteins.
Tubulin post-translational modifications and lattice properties form a biologically meaningful tubulin code affecting stability, trafficking and cellular function.

multiscale_causal_chain.requirement: Every promoted mechanism must specify at least one measurable map L_k -> L_(k+1), its timescale and its effect size. Skipping levels by analogy is not a causal model.
multiscale_causal_chain.generic_mediation: microstate q -> mesoscopic variable m -> neural variable n -> behavioral/report y; test whether q adds predictive/causal information about y after m,n and confounders are modeled.

classical_physics_baseline.driven_dissipative_modes: M q_ddot + Gamma q_dot + K q = xi(t)
classical_physics_baseline.electrical_mechanical_extension: M q_ddot+Gamma q_dot+K q = B_E E(t)+B_F F(t)+xi(t) as a schematic forced model once couplings are measured
classical_physics_baseline.meaning: Before invoking coherent quantum information, estimate ordinary mode spectra, damping, thermal/noise forcing and coupling to cellular variables.
classical_physics_baseline.baseline_rule: A quantum model must outperform a classical stochastic/dissipative model on an observable that is actually quantum-sensitive.

quantum_model_contract.hamiltonian: H_MT=sum_n hbar omega_n(a_n^dagger a_n+1/2)+H_int is only a starting comparator after physical modes are defined.
quantum_model_contract.timescale_gate: A necessary but not sufficient condition for a proposed coherent mechanism is tau_coh comparable to or longer than the relevant interaction/control time tau_int. tau_coh >> tau_int still does not show functional importance without causal coupling and readout.
quantum_model_contract.entanglement_gate: Claims of entanglement require an entanglement witness, Bell-type protocol or state reconstruction appropriate to the system; ordinary correlation or synchronized neural activity is insufficient.

quantum_consciousness_status.orch_or: Penrose-Hameroff Orch OR proposes cognitively relevant quantum processing in neuronal microtubules; it remains controversial rather than established neuroscience.
quantum_consciousness_status.decoherence_debate: Published estimates differ because they model different degrees of freedom, environments and shielding assumptions. The existence of a debate does not establish a consciousness mechanism.
quantum_consciousness_status.2026_status: Recent work continues both proposed quantum mechanisms and critical evaluation; operational demonstration of neural-scale entanglement/coherence and uniquely quantum explanatory necessity remains insufficient/contested.

great_book_model.microtubules: Tubulin-based cylindrical cytoskeletal structures are proposed in the book as one candidate interface between ordinary neural physiology and the speculative Spirit layer.
great_book_model.note: Historical numerical biological claims should not be reused as empirical constants unless their primary scientific sources and measurement contexts are recovered.

coarse_graining_and_door.scientific_question: Which statistics of the microscopic state are sufficient to predict a neuronal/network variable?
coarse_graining_and_door.information_test: Compare I(q_micro;X_neural_future | X_neural_past,controls) or an appropriate causal/predictive measure against null/surrogate models; information association alone still does not establish direct causality.
coarse_graining_and_door.intervention_test: Perturb the candidate microtubule variable selectively where feasible and test whether predicted downstream neural effects occur after accounting for toxicity/general cytoskeletal disruption.
coarse_graining_and_door.project_translation: Door is a cross-scale interface only if a measurable map and intervention path exist.

neural_scale.network_state: Use neural population/circuit variables at this level rather than assigning the same microscopic phase to whole-brain dynamics.
neural_scale.bridge_requirement: Derive or estimate how microtubule perturbations change parameters of the circuit model. Otherwise the two equations are merely adjacent descriptions.

experimental_ladder: 1. Characterize microtubule mechanical/electrical mode spectra, damping and temperature dependence in controlled preparations.
2. Measure whether candidate modes alter motor transport, membrane/cellular variables or synaptic function at physiological amplitudes.
3. Use selective perturbations to separate microtubule-specific effects from broad cytotoxic/cytoskeletal disruption.
4. Quantify the resulting effect on neuronal/circuit observables.
5. Only for a quantum hypothesis, measure a quantum-specific observable and show that a classical stochastic model fails.
6. Connect the validated cellular/circuit effect to behavior or conscious-state transitions with preregistered outcomes.
7. Replicate across preparations/labs before promoting a cross-scale mechanism.
hard_boundaries: Logging onto a website, eating from a symbolic Tree of Strife, moral choices or social fixation are not known to induce quantum entanglement of neural microtubules.
Quantum entanglement does not permit ordinary controllable faster-than-light communication or prove telepathy.
Room-temperature molecular quantum effects can exist without implying a quantum computer or a quantum theory of consciousness.
Microtubules are biologically important even if quantum-consciousness hypotheses fail; the classical cytoskeletal/transport/plasticity branch stands independently.
falsification_and_failure_conditions: Candidate microscopic dynamics have no reproducible effect on downstream neuronal variables at physiological conditions.
Observed downstream effects are fully explained by general cytoskeletal disruption/toxicity rather than the proposed mechanism.
A quantum model does not outperform classical stochastic alternatives on quantum-sensitive observables.
Relevant coherence/entanglement cannot persist or be controlled/read out on the timescale required by the mechanism.
No validated causal chain connects the molecular effect to neural computation and behavior/report.
new_research_program: Separate tubulin lattice dynamics, electromagnetic response, transport biology, neural synchronization and consciousness into distinct model levels.
Replace vague 'quantum computer' wording with explicit Hamiltonian, bath/decoherence model, quantum witness and timescale when discussing quantum variants.
Define and estimate a coarse-graining map from microtubule variables to neuronal/network observables.
Audit every Great Book frequency, piezoelectric coefficient, neurotransmitter concentration and decoherence value against primary peer-reviewed sources before reusing it.
Use intervention and model comparison to determine whether microtubules add explanatory power beyond established cellular/neural mechanisms.
